items.title: 9.9 Acid-base indicators (rang se acid ya base batane wali cheezen) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9, printed pages 205-206.

blocks.title: Indicator
blocks.text: Indicator woh substance (cheez) hai jo titration ka endpoint (aakhri point) dikhane ke liye colour badalta hai.

Acid-base indicators acid mein ek colour (rang) aur base mein doosra colour dikhate hain. Acid-base titration mein istemal hone wale zyada tar indicators weak organic acids ya weak organic bases hote hain. Solution mein weak-acid indicator (HIn) ko is equation se dikhate hain:

In⁻ indicator ke anion (negative ion) hisse ka symbol (nishan) hai. Reaction reversible hai, is liye HIn aur In⁻ dono maujood rehte hain. Colour is liye nazar aata hai ke HIn aur In⁻ ke colours different hain.

Acidic solution mein jo In⁻ ions hain woh Brønsted bases ki tarah acid se protons le lete hain, is liye indicator zyada tar bina ionize hui shakal HIn mein hota hai. Basic solution mein base ke OH⁻ ions indicator ke H⁺ ions se mil jate hain (pani ban jata hai). H⁺ ki is kami ko poora karne ke liye indicator ke molecules aur ionize hote hain, aur indicator zyada tar apne anion In⁻ ki shakal mein aa jata hai. Ab solution base wala colour dikhata hai; litmus ke liye yeh blue hai.

blocks.alt: Chhoti blue H ball bari grey In ball se juri hai (HIn). Daen taraf arrow 'In basic solution' aur baen taraf arrow 'In acidic solution' blue H ball (positive charge) plus bari red In ball (negative charge) ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.1: Un-ionised acid-base indicators aur un ki ionised forms equilibrium mein hoti hain (kitab ki doosri Figure 9.1 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen taraf poora molecule HIn hai (ek colour). Daen taraf H⁺ alag ho gaya hai aur In⁻ bacha hai (doosra colour). Basic solution mein equilibrium daen taraf (In⁻) jata hai, acidic solution mein baen taraf (HIn).

Different indicators different pH par colour badalte hain. Colour is par depend karta hai ke us pH par HIn aur In⁻ kitni kitni amount mein hain. Example: methyl red pH 4.4 aur 6.2 ke darmiyan red se yellow hota hai. pH 4.4 par indicator zyada tar HIn molecules ki shakal mein hota hai, jo red nazar aate hain. Kuch aam indicators ki ranges neeche hain:

blocks.alt: pH 0 se 14 ke scale ke oopar do colour bars. Methyl orange: kam pH par red, taqreeban pH 3.2 aur 4.5 ke darmiyan orange se yellow, us ke baad yellow. Phenolphthalein: taqreeban pH 8.2 tak colourless, pH 10 tak pink se red, us ke baad red.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2: Kuch aam acid-base indicators ki range aur colour ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har colour bar ek indicator hai. Methyl orange acidic solution mein red hai aur pH taqreeban 4.5 se oopar yellow; colour pH 3.2 se 4.5 ke darmiyan badalta hai. Phenolphthalein pH 8.2 tak colourless hai aur 10 tak pink-red ho jata hai. Yani har indicator sirf apni chhoti si range mein colour badalta hai.

items: Indicator (weak organic acid ya base) HIn ⇌ H⁺ + In⁻: acid mein HIn ka colour, base mein In⁻ ka colour.
Har indicator ki apni pH range hai: methyl red pH 4.4 par red, 6.2 tak yellow.
